title: a `completer` style naming a function that does not exist: zsh reports it, zshrs ignores it

observed.fingerprint_label: cell/row0/col0 | ref/$ CC _main_complete:#: command not found: _fasd_zsh_word_complete_trigger | test/$ CC

rows.zshrs: bench/        daemon/       editors/      man/          src/          test_corpus/  typeset.tmp/

observed.notes: Two names in the chain do not exist on this host (_megacomplete and _fasd_zsh_word_complete_trigger). zsh runs the chain far enough to hit the missing function and prints 'command not found'; zshrs silently skips it. The match-set half of the difference is fixture cc_match_set showing through — the diagnostic is what is new here.

variants.note: confirmed 2026-08-30 (FAIL, 3 rows, fingerprint 7b20398e3e): same missing-function diagnostic, plus the tag list in the format line differs — zsh '`input files', `files', or `last args'' vs zshrs '... `fasd ranked files', `fasd ranked directories', ...'.
confirmed 2026-08-30 (FAIL, 3 rows, fingerprint 2c3fbfd907): with a ctrl-g abort after the tab, zsh leaves 'CC   ib' plus the diagnostic, zshrs leaves the inserted match 'CC   bench'.

zshrs_binary.kind: debug build under target/ (NOT the Homebrew-installed zshrs)

zsh_binary.note: Homebrew zsh 5.9.2, which is what `zsh` on PATH resolves to here; /bin/zsh is an older build and is NOT what any harness runs.

confirmed.note: round 6 re-confirmation, from the full gate run in tests/compsys_fixtures/last_gate.json. What that run established: verdict STILL-DIVERGES; the harness's own detail was '4 row(s) differ'; failure fingerprint 19376c78e1, unchanged

history.note: all three harness files had uncommitted edits when this was confirmed (three agents were editing them concurrently); the sha256 prefixes above pin the exact bytes used.
